rule: Full original cancellation of a v8-born Workflow is a separate genuine dependency. The limited execution revocation of Plans/goal_run_replan_contracts/source-v8/STOP-PROTOCOL.md (StopAcceptedRevocation, StopRevocationReadback, ExecutionRevocationReadback) never issues, substitutes for or counts as any item below, and a replan never performs cancellation (correction C7). Each item keeps its own owner, full source union and refusal; current source loss or an unsupported effect refuses rather than leaving the census.

Native cancel result and origin under the v8 profile-qualified workflow_cancel_result v7 and workflow_cancel_origin v7 headers
Effect cleanup and settlement of every in-flight effect (FileSafe, Process, bounded safe-stop); an unsupported or unknown effect owner stays unresolved and blocks dependent release

scope: Project Workflow scope only (CV-366 row goal_run.replanned: preserve_project_only; GRS-079 Project-bound source edition). No application Goal is converted and no retired child Goal or role concept is revived through these source shapes.
